objectives.statement: Recognize and form regular indefinite plural nouns with r or er.
Recognize short neuter nouns that do not change in the indefinite plural.
Use common definite plural endings to mean the plural nouns.
Recognize common irregular plural nouns used in everyday Norwegian.

notes: Must teach regular indefinite plural -(e)r, short neuter zero plural, definite plural -(e)ne, and common irregular plurals such as barn/barna, mann/menn, bok/bøker, mor/mødre.
